docking.center_note: co-crystallised pemetrexed (LYA, chain A) centroid — verified by dock._ligand_center; NOT the NADP+ cofactor centroid [13.62, -7.64, 12.2]
docking.correction_note: Pipeline ChEMBL retrieval mis-mapped the target to human maltase-glucoamylase (CHEMBL2074); its docked 'leads' were iminosugars/hydrazone, not PTR1 inhibitors. This run docks genuine TbPTR1 inhibitors from the literature on the identical centre/box. Pipeline methotrexate score -9.05 on 2X9G is reproduced here in the same run.
